study: TypeA frozen models on TypeB under unavailable-feature input mapping
selection_rule: Top five TypeA supplementary TEST F1 candidates, tie by trial ID; additionally include original TypeA baseline.
mapping_policy: Exact canonical feature name and time-window match; preserve original TypeB values and missingness. Unavailable TypeA columns are NaN, not zero. No aggregation of 15m/1h into unsupported 6h or raw-event features.
mapping_assumption: Shared official feature names and windows are used as the available correspondence; different hardware distributions and unavailable columns limit transfer interpretation.

metrics.metric_scope: Local device F1 with frozen task lead interval. Alarmed fault with no in-window hit counts FP and FN. Unknown follow-up excluded and reported separately.
